name: Eiger Trail

hero.subtitle_html: Alpiglen → Eigergletscher under the Eiger north face — SAC T2 · ~160 m gain · ~6.4 km · ~3 h

intro_html: The Eiger Trail is one of the clearest examples of the spec-driven workflow: short approach, famous objective, straightforward GPX routing, and a small number of sections to override. It is a good starter example for parallel agents because the route narrative is simple and the logistics are unusually clean.
quick_facts: Balcony trail below the Eiger north face
Clear-weather half day with dramatic scenery

getting_there.by_pt_html:
• Train to Grindelwald Terminal or Kleine Scheidegg corridor, then WAB to Alpiglen.
  • Finish at Eigergletscher and ride down by Jungfrau rail / gondola connection.
getting_there.by_car_html: Parking is simplest at Grindelwald Terminal; use mountain rail for the start and finish.

weather.season_html: Best window: late June to October, depending on snow lingering under the north face.

lapse_rate.example_html: Example: 20 °C in Grindelwald → about 12 °C near Eigergletscher.
